author: priya.raman@enterprise.com
body: The validator is a shared library. Refund Service links the same package, so any new mandatory field breaks refunds exactly like BUG-332 did. Please keep the new currency check optional on the refund path or version the contract.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: Agreed scope with product: full currency matrix for the top 6 settlement currencies plus the zero-decimal (JPY) and three-decimal (BHD) edge cases. Manual exploratory pass on the merchant config screen is not needed for this change.

author: priya.raman@enterprise.com
body: Decision: UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY must be raised before funds are reserved, not after. Confirmed with treasury that no reservation may exist for a rejected currency.

author: marek.novak@enterprise.com
body: Currency Service call is now on the validation hot path. If the rate feed is slow we add latency to every payment. We saw this pattern in BUG-288 with the fraud vendor - please add a timeout and a cached-catalogue fallback.

author: sofia.lindqvist@enterprise.com
body: Out of scope for this ECR: invoice currency symbol rendering (tracked separately). In scope: storing both the original and converted settlement amount on the transaction record.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: TC-1035 has been flaky since the rate-cache change. Historical failure rate is around 30%. Treat a failure here as a real signal, not noise.

author: arjun.mehta@enterprise.com
body: Implementation note: supported-currency list is read once per request from the merchant config and cached for 60s. validate_currency() now returns UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY without calling the rate feed at all.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: BUG-201 was reopened twice because the fix only checked code length. Please add the ISO-4217 catalogue assertion to the regression pack, not just the merchant list check.

author: lena.fischer@enterprise.com
body: Copy approved by content design: 'Save changes'. Toast wording stays as is. No API or persistence change, so backend regression is not required.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: Scope: profile page UI tests plus one accessibility check on the button label. No payment or order regression needed.

author: hannah.pereira@enterprise.com
body: BUG-160 was caused by exactly this pattern: a NOT NULL column deployed before the service change. This migration must be expand-migrate-contract with a nullable column first.

author: marek.novak@enterprise.com
body: Backfill of 340M rows must run in batches outside the settlement window. Reporting reads the same table and already breached its budget in BUG-166.

author: aisha.khan@enterprise.com
body: Ledger must be migrated in the same release. A settlement_currency column that the ledger does not read would break reconciliation parity.

author: tomas.silva@enterprise.com
body: Step-up assertion must be bound to the payment amount and the device trust claim. BUG-228 showed that a token refresh silently dropped device trust and skipped MFA entirely.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: Security regression must include the refresh-token path and the high-value payment threshold boundary. Payment authorisation tests must run as well since the assertion check sits in front of authorisation.

author: lena.fischer@enterprise.com
body: Template variables unchanged - only header and footer markup. BUG-256 was caused by a variable rename, which does not apply here.

author: priya.raman@enterprise.com
body: v2 keeps v1 live for two releases. The refund aggregate lock closes the BUG-205 concurrency gap; please add a concurrent partial-refund test to the pack.

author: arjun.mehta@enterprise.com
body: Rounding now happens after discounts, per currency minor units. This directly addresses the BUG-193 capture mismatch.

author: marek.novak@enterprise.com
body: Vendor call stays synchronous in checkout. Fail-open timeout must be configurable - BUG-288 took checkout down for 40 minutes when the previous vendor slowed.

author: r.iyer@rail.example
body: TBC246 moves from 80 to 85 psi. The prompt wording is unchanged and still renders the parameter value at runtime, so no HMI string update is required.

author: k.whitfield@rail.example
body: Boundary cases must be re-run at 84/85/86 psi. PTC-4188 showed the feed valve validity flag is evaluated before the status is latched, so the negative cases matter more than the positive ones.

author: r.iyer@rail.example
body: Feed valve validity window TBC118 is unchanged by this ECR, but the latch order is being fixed in the same drop.

author: k.whitfield@rail.example
body: This is the exact scenario of PTC-4101: the key availability check enumerated ACTIVE and DISENGAGED only. Adding CUT OUT must be covered for all three states plus the negative cases for parking function and cut out switch.

author: m.dubois@rail.example
body: Menu 1 layout is untouched by this change; only key availability logic. Layout is handled by ECR-2026-013.

author: m.dubois@rail.example
body: Key order change approved by the crew review board. Greying behaviour for unsatisfied preconditions is unchanged.

author: arjun.mehta@enterprise.com
body: Holding stock at add-to-cart ties up inventory during flash sales. BUG-401 oversold because the reservation had no row lock - keep the lock and add the 15 minute expiry job.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: Scope: label generation for both carriers and the carrier mapping table. BUG-402 came from a stale mapping, so include the new service codes in the regression pack.

author: lena.fischer@enterprise.com
body: Decision: show 'Only N left' below 5 units, otherwise just 'In stock'. Approved by content design.

author: priya.raman@enterprise.com
body: Coupon redemption must be idempotent per order. BUG-404 applied a coupon twice on a retried checkout - reuse the order idempotency key.

author: sofia.lindqvist@enterprise.com
body: The campaign runs for two weeks for premium members only. No change to points for cancelled orders.

author: marek.novak@enterprise.com
body: Three retries per renewal triple the load on the Payment Service at month start. Spread the retries over the day and keep the plan currency - see BUG-406.

author: priya.raman@enterprise.com
body: Decision: credit the wallet only on capture, never on authorisation. BUG-407 shows what happens when the balance check and debit are not atomic.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: BUG-408 posted a chargeback reversal twice because webhook retries were not de-duplicated. Add a duplicate webhook test before release.

author: hannah.pereira@enterprise.com
body: Daily payouts must read a live KYC status. BUG-409 released funds from a cached status - no caching on this path.

author: sofia.lindqvist@enterprise.com
body: In scope: OSS thresholds and per-invoice VAT rounding. Out of scope: US sales tax.

author: ravi.kumar@enterprise.com
body: Re-verification reuses the onboarding document checks, including the expiry date check added after BUG-411.

author: elena.rossi@enterprise.com
body: Decision: consent is checked at send time. The nightly snapshot caused BUG-412 and must not be used for marketing sends.

author: arjun.mehta@enterprise.com
body: The audit publisher whitelist now reads event types from configuration, so new admin events do not need a code change.

author: lena.fischer@enterprise.com
body: Scope: ranking checks on the top 50 search queries. No checkout or payment regression needed.

author: tomas.berg@enterprise.com
body: Biometric tokens are device-bound but must still be revoked on password change. BUG-415 left mobile sessions alive after revocation.

author: marek.novak@enterprise.com
body: Partition by transaction id, not merchant id, or ledger consumers see events out of order again (BUG-416). Plan a dual-publish window.

author: daniel.okafor@enterprise.com
body: BUG-417: the portal once bypassed refund validation. Test a refund above the captured amount from the portal.

author: hannah.pereira@enterprise.com
body: Only the extract query changes. Reconcile totals against the ledger for three days after release (see BUG-418).

author: sofia.lindqvist@enterprise.com
body: The gift card balance is used first, then the saved card for the remainder. Expired cards are skipped.

author: arjun.mehta@enterprise.com
body: The refund must be triggered by the return approval event. BUG-420 approved returns without refunds when the event was not published.

author: karen.walsh@rail.example
body: The TBC008 change to 6 seconds is approved by the safety review board. The warning must still precede enforcement (PTC-4501).

author: james.carter@rail.example
body: PTC-4502 used the default consist length in the braking curve. Test missing, zero and maximum consist values.

author: maria.lopez@rail.example
body: Scope: recorder entries for acknowledgements plus a power-cycle test, since PTC-4503 lost records on power loss.

author: karen.walsh@rail.example
body: Track numbers must stay strings. PTC-4504 applied a restriction to the wrong track after the leading zero was dropped.

author: samuel.green@rail.example
body: PTC-4505 is still open: the aspect table was off by one after a firmware update. Fix it before adding new codes.

author: maria.lopez@rail.example
body: The self-test now reads the antenna status live instead of the cached value that hid PTC-4506.

author: noah.fischer@rail.example
body: Keep-alive frames without payload reset the loss timer in PTC-4507. Confirm the new timer ignores them.

author: olivia.hart@rail.example
body: Badge scan login is approved by the crew review board. Manual entry stays available as a fallback.

author: james.carter@rail.example
body: Heavy haul only; standard consists keep the current curve. Overspeed warning timing is out of scope.

author: james.carter@rail.example
body: Checksums are generated by the back office build pipeline and shipped with each configuration file.
